column3: “Makes his face shine, and the strength of his face is changed” is rendered “illumines him and causes his stern face to beam.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB supplies “I say” and quotation marks, and “the oath of God” is rendered “the oath before God.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Do not be hasty; from before him you will go” is rendered “Do not be in a hurry to leave him,” and “stand in” as “join in.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Mastery” is rendered “authoritative.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Will not know an evil thing” is rendered “experiences no trouble,” and “custom” as “procedure.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Matter” is rendered “delight,” and “for” as “when.”
Close to the Hebrew; “For he does not know” is rendered “If no one knows,” and “just as it will be” as “when it will happen.”
NASB adds “with the wind” (“to restrain the wind with the wind”); “the battle” is rendered “the time of war.”
Close to the Hebrew; “For his evil” is rendered “to his hurt.”
The Hebrew is difficult: “they came and went from the holy place” is rendered “used to go in and out,” and “where they had done right” as “where they did thus.” The meaning is uncertain.
Close to the Hebrew; “It is full” is rendered “are given fully.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “his life,” and “who fear before him” is rendered “who fear Him openly.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “On the other hand.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Gladness” is rendered “pleasure,” and “it will accompany him” as “this will stand by him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “Sleep in his eyes he does not see” is rendered “even though one should never sleep,” placed in parentheses.
Close to the Hebrew; NASB adds “I concluded.”
